t: This is St James' Church, a Church of England parish church on Prebend Street in Islington, between Essex Road and the New North Road. Its parish stretches from Upper Street and the Angel across to City Road and the Regent's Canal. The church was designed by Frederick William Porter, an Anglo-Irish architect. Beyond that, there isn't much more I can tell you with confidence, so take a moment to look at the building itself and the street around it.
